1) Slot 1 (45m) — System design (Karthik) — deep dive into latency/cost trade-offs
2) Slot 2 (45m) — Backend implementation / API design (Irene) — include short coding exercise (take-home style, 10m)

- Preferred day: Option A (morning) is fine for our east-coast interviewers, but confirm Karthik availability.
